title: FB-005 harden pending publish reveal evidence
summary: Hardened pending publish sidecar reveal evidence and deferred publish result sizing for FB-005.
reason: Worker findings FR-011 and FR-012 identified two pending-publish safety gaps: failed final sidecar backup could be treated like no prior sidecar existed, and deferred publish result evidence could read size after the local output had already moved.
behavior_before: Publish sidecar backup returned only a nullable backup path, so callers could not distinguish no existing sidecar from a failed backup of an existing sidecar. Deferred/output-space pending publish branches could derive result output size from the moved local output path and report zero bytes.
behavior_after: Publish sidecar backup returns explicit state, immediate publish and pending drain fail closed before reveal/write when an existing final sidecar cannot be backed up, and restore avoids deleting prior proof after backup failure. Pending park success returns the transaction object, and deferred/output-space publish result evidence uses the transaction output-size proof.
tests_added: Pending publish safety checks assert that Invoke-ParkPendingPush returns a transaction whose OutputSize matches pending manifest output_size.
Pending publish safety checks simulate existing final sidecar backup failure and prove prior sidecar proof remains in place.
